title: Anna and Tom
text:
Anna meets Tom at the park. "Hello, Tom!" says Anna. "How are you?" "I am fine, thanks," says Tom. They walk together.

Tom has a red ball. "Can I play with you?" asks Anna. "Yes, of course!" says Tom. They play in the sun. Then they say goodbye.

questions.text: How do Anna and Tom feel at the end of the story?
How does Tom feel about playing with Anna?
options: He does not want to play

paragraph_translations: Anna se encuentra con Tom en el parque. "¡Hola, Tom!" dice Anna. "¿Cómo estás?" "Estoy bien, gracias", dice Tom. Caminan juntos.
Tom tiene una pelota roja. "¿Puedo jugar contigo?" pregunta Anna. "¡Sí, claro!" dice Tom. Juegan al sol. Luego se despiden.
